responsibility: This header declares the runtime module dependency interface used by the mc-boot startup system. It defines the init/fini callback type and exports the procedures for registering modules, requesting extra dependencies, and constructing or deconstructing modules in resolved order, forming the public API of the module-ordering subsystem beneath M2RTS.
same_name_distinction: Exposes the module-dependency registration and construction/deconstruction API, while GM2Dependent.cc contains the internal module-chain structures and dependency-resolution/order-execution machinery.
